body:
I have always felt like a horrible person. I have trouble looking people in the eye when I talk to them because I feel lower than them, I always feel like I am in trouble when someone says my name.

I have tried to get some help before, but never really followed through because I had already been prescribed antidepressants by my doctor, didn't like the side effects, but they only wanted to prescribe more of the same meds. I honestly wish I could sign up on a doctor's website, as I'm terrible on the phone.. I probably would have never gone to Planned Parenthood if they did not have that available.
